narr: The combination of moderate instability and a weak upper level disturbance resulted in scattered thunderstorms across much of west central Texas. A few storms were severe.
ev: Law enforcement reports high water rescues ongoing in Abilene. Also, a flooded home was reported at the 1200 block of Westmoreland St.
